title: arenaria aggregata subsp. racemosa
intro: Arenaria aggregata subsp. racemosa, commonly known as Rock Candy or Mountain Candy, is a plant species within the carnation family that is native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean and Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which offer various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Rock Candy include its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties and ability to soothe the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of Rock Candy include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
